```yaml
name: Analyze reusable workflow

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      os:
        description: 'Operating system to run on'
        required: false
        default: 'ubuntu-latest'
      run-packaging:
        description: 'Run packaging step'
        required: false
        default: 'true'
      run-tests:
        description: 'Run tests step'
        required: false
        default: 'true'

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1
        with:
          version: '7.4'

      - name: Install dpkg-dev
        if: ${{ inputs.run-packaging == 'true' }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y dpkg-dev
        shell: bash

      - name: Build packages
        if: ${{ inputs.run-packaging == 'true' }}
        run: |
          pwsh -Command "Import-Module ./tools/packaging/packaging.psm1; Build-Packages"
        shell: pwsh

      - name: Run packaging validation tests
        if: ${{ inputs.run-tests == 'true' }}
        run: |
          pwsh -File test/packaging/linux/package-validation.tests.ps1
        shell: pwsh
```
